title: UnDercontrol Budget Resource
description: Schema for budget YAML resource files. Budgets track planned spending with recurring plans and one-time adjustments. Applying an existing budget only appends: plans and adjustments missing on the server are added, nothing is deleted, and initial_amount / starts_at cannot be changed. All amounts are currently stored in CNY; the ud CLI refuses any other currency rather than storing it as CNY.

initial_amount.description: Opening balance of the budget. Defaults to 0. Cannot be changed after creation: record later changes under adjustments.

amount.description: Deprecated. Older documents used this as both the plan amount and the opening balance, which opened the budget with an extra period's money. Now: the plan amount when plans is empty, ignored when plans is given, never the opening balance. Use plans and initial_amount.

starts_at.description: Budget start date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601.

plans.description: Recurring budget plans. Each plan defines a periodic amount.

frequency.description: How often the plan amount is applied.

effective_to.description: Plan end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for open-ended.

reason.description: Why this plan was created or changed.

example.description:
Example budget YAML:

apiVersion: ud/v1
kind: Budget
metadata:
  tags: [food]
spec:
  name: Groceries
  initial_amount:
    amount: 0
    currency: CNY
  starts_at: "2025-01-01"
  plans:
    - amount:
        amount: 500.00
        currency: CNY
      frequency: monthly
      effective_from: "2025-01-01"
      reason: Initial monthly budget
  adjustments:
    - amount:
        amount: 120.00
        currency: CNY
      adjustment_date: "2025-03-15"
      reason: Birthday gift
